rules.name: Authentication failure
rules.explanation: Records a single failed PAM authentication attempt.
possible_reactions: Check whether the account and login source are expected.
Review nearby authentication events for repeated failures.

rules.name: Repeated file access denials
rules.explanation: Detects repeated denied file access by one account within five minutes.
possible_reactions: Review the account and requested files for unauthorized probing.
Correct permissions only after confirming the access is legitimate.

rules.name: Repeated password failures
rules.explanation: Detects repeated PAM authentication failures for one account within two minutes.
possible_reactions: Review recent login attempts for the affected account.
Reset credentials or restrict access if the attempts are unauthorized.

rules.name: Web/API password guessing
rules.explanation: Detects repeated Web/API password failures from the same source for one account within five minutes.
possible_reactions: Review the source address and account activity.
Block the source or rotate the account password if abuse is confirmed.

rules.name: Unknown account guessing
rules.explanation: Detects repeated authentication failures without a known account name within two minutes.
possible_reactions: Review authentication logs for the attempted names and origin.
Restrict the source if enumeration is confirmed.

rules.name: Authentication source probing
rules.explanation: Detects many authentication failures from one source within five minutes when enabled.
possible_reactions: Review the source address and targeted accounts.
Restrict the source if probing is confirmed.

rules.pattern: ^usb [0-9]+-[0-9.]+: New USB device found, idVendor=[0-9a-f]{4}, idProduct=[0-9a-f]{4}
rules.name: USB device connected
rules.explanation: Records a new physical USB device reported by the kernel, excluding root hubs.
possible_reactions: Identify the device and confirm that its connection was authorized.
Disconnect or block an unapproved device.

rules.pattern: ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_.-]* : +(user NOT in sudoers|user NOT authorized on host|command not allowed) ;
rules.name: Sudo policy violation
rules.explanation: Records one denied sudo command or unauthorized sudo policy attempt.
possible_reactions: Review the user and attempted command.
Investigate unexpected privilege requests.

rules.pattern: ^(add '[^']+' to group '(sudo|admin|adm|root|wheel|shadow|disk|docker|lxd)'|user \S+ added by \S+ to group (sudo|admin|adm|root|wheel|shadow|disk|docker|lxd))$
rules.name: Privileged group membership changed
rules.explanation: Records an account added to a privileged system group.
possible_reactions: Verify the group change against an approved administrator action.
Remove unauthorized membership and review the account.

rules.pattern: ^new user: name=[^,]+, UID=[0-9]+, GID=[0-9]+, home=[^,]*, shell=/
rules.name: Login account created
rules.explanation: Records a newly created login capable account.
possible_reactions: Confirm that the new account was approved.
Disable an unauthorized account and review its activity.

rules.name: Root password changed
possible_reactions: Confirm the change with the responsible administrator.
Rotate credentials and investigate if the change was unexpected.

rules.name: User password changed
rules.explanation: Records a password change for an account other than root.
possible_reactions: Confirm the account owner requested the change.
Investigate unexpected changes and reset the password if needed.

rules.name: Root SSH login
rules.explanation: Records a successful root login over SSH.
possible_reactions: Confirm the source address and administrator activity.
Disable direct root SSH access if it is not approved.

rules.name: Root su session opened
rules.explanation: Records a session opened as root through su.
possible_reactions: Review the originating account and session activity.
Investigate an unapproved privilege escalation.

rules.pattern: ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_.-]* : +(user NOT in sudoers|user NOT authorized on host|command not allowed) ;
rules.name: Repeated sudo denials
rules.explanation: Detects repeated denied sudo requests by one account within five minutes.
possible_reactions: Review the account and attempted commands.
Restrict the account if privilege probing is confirmed.

rules.name: SSH login probing
rules.explanation: Detects repeated SSH invalid user or failed login attempts from one source within five minutes.
possible_reactions: Review the source address and affected accounts.
Block the source if the activity is hostile.

rules.pattern: ^pam_faillock\([a-z-]+:auth\): Consecutive login failures for user \S+ account temporarily locked$
rules.account_pattern: ^pam_faillock\([a-z-]+:auth\): Consecutive login failures for user (\S+) account temporarily locked$
rules.name: Account locked after failed logins
rules.explanation: Records an account lockout caused by consecutive failed login attempts.
possible_reactions: Confirm whether the account owner caused the failures.
Reset credentials or investigate the source before unlocking.

rules.pattern: ^pam_faillock\([a-z-]+:auth\): Consecutive login failures for user \S+ account temporarily locked$
rules.account_pattern: ^pam_faillock\([a-z-]+:auth\): Consecutive login failures for user (\S+) account temporarily locked$
rules.name: Repeated account lockouts
rules.explanation: Detects repeated lockouts of one account within 75 minutes.
possible_reactions: Investigate the affected account and login sources.
Protect the account and restrict abusive sources.
